name: The Empty Locker
description: Irina asks why a worker assigned to a night shift has not returned.
offerText: Irina asks why a worker assigned to a night shift has not returned.

stages.description: Ask Irina about the missing worker and his assigned shift.
Inspect the worker’s locker in the factory changing area; record the maintenance slip.
Ask Dusan about the maintenance slip and sealed workshop.
Tell Irina what the slip reveals, without claiming the worker is dead.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Irina asks why a worker assigned to a night shift has not returned.
implementationNotes: Add interactable factory locker and maintenance-slip quest evidence; inspect-locker is a dialogue-style interaction stub until world-object trigger support exists.
Implement worker locker interaction to emit the stage choiceId or replace stage trigger with supported inspect trigger.
Worker is missing, not confirmed dead; Irina wants discretion.
